messages:
sam.theo: Heads up — docusaurus build failed on the docs site. linkcheck shows a fragment mismatch for /getting-started/installation.html#installing-the-sdk-js

maria.g: I saw that in CI. The TOC links point to `#installing-the-sdk-`js`` (with backticks in the slug) but the rendered HTML anchor is `#installing-the-sdk-js` (backticks stripped). Looks like our slugifier is inconsistent between TOC generation and MDX heading rendering.

kai: Can you paste the MDX heading that caused it?

sam.theo: It's this one in getting-started/installation.mdx:
```mdx
## Installing the SDK `js`
```

devx-bot: linkcheck summary:
- Pages checked: 298
- Broken fragments: 1 (getting-started/installation.mdx -> TOC ref '#installing-the-sdk-`js`' not found)

maria.g: Docusaurus uses a slugifier for headings when generating anchors, but our TOC generator (script that builds sidebar links) is URL-encoding or preserving inline code backticks differently. Quick fix options:
- change the heading to include parentheses instead of inline code: `## Installing the SDK (JavaScript)`
- set an explicit id: `## Installing the SDK {#installing-the-sdk-js} `
- modify the TOC generator to run the same slugify function as docusaurus (longer).

kai: I prefer option 2 for short-term. Option 1 changes semantics in a visible way. Option 3 is ideal but riskier.

sam.theo: I'll open a tiny PR with the explicit id so CI unblocks, and add a comment to follow up on harmonizing slugification. Patch:
```diff
- ## Installing the SDK `js`
+ ## Installing the SDK {#installing-the-sdk-js} `js`
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2402 (WIP)

docs-ci: Running `pnpm docs:linkcheck` on branch fix/install-anchor-2402

devx-bot: Suggestion — also add a smoke test in CI that compares sidebar-generated anchors with built HTML anchors for a handful of pages. We had a similar mismatch before.

maria.g: Good call. After this merges I can draft a follow-up PR that either normalizes slugify usage or adds the smoke test.

kai: If we go for normalization later, we should pick the docusaurus slugifier (since that's the canonical renderer). I'll add a note in the follow-up PR to use `@docusaurus/utils` slugify helper.

sam.theo: CI green locally for me. Pushed the PR. Tagging @kai for review.

kai: Reviewing now. Tiny nit about whitespace but LGTM once CI passes.

maria.g: Merged. Dev site linkcheck now passes and the install page anchor resolves. Leaving the slugify follow-up on the backlog.

docs-ci: deploy preview available at https://deploy-preview-2402--docs.redwood.ai/ (anchor fixed)

sam.theo: Thanks everyone. Adding a short note to the docs handbook about avoiding inline code-only fragments in headings to reduce churn.
